notes.title: Brought to you from a Steam Deck
notes.notes:
[h1]Brought to you from a Steam Deck[/h1]

Slingshot Pilot has been developed with the [i]Steam Deck[/i] as the main device for dev.
The Deck is a suprisingly complete linux development environment and allows for fast and comfortable development, when docked to a regular USB-C to use keyboard, mouse and an external screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45486956/a14c961c6bbc7078df59146f6095938d1bc15d42.jpg[/img]
The Acer PC you see in the image is just my "cross-plattform" test device for windows..

It's been a blast so far. And working directly on the [i]Deck[/i] helped design specifically for it,
[b]maximizing compatibility[/b]. I am sure you will have as much fun playing [b]Slingshot Pilot[/b] on the [i]Deck[/i] as I had developing it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45486956/41a901933aa0339bad3acc8caa1e94ab2ec87455.jpg[/img]
